actions.description: Crash worker with kill -9 mid-drain, verify recovery
actions.command:
set -e
# Batch 1: crash the worker while it drains a big batch
for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -s -o /dev/null -d "crash-batch-$i" http://127.0.0.1:8080/jobs/crash-$i; done
WPID=$(systemctl show -p MainPID --value queue-worker.service)
kill -9 $WPID
echo "killed worker pid $WPID at $(date +%T)"
sleep 4   # systemd Restart=always brings it back
systemctl is-active queue-worker.service
echo "=== crash-batch results ==="
sqlite3 /var/lib/job-queue/jobs.sqlite3 "SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM jobs WHERE id LIKE 'crash-%' GROUP BY status; SELECT COUNT(*) AS not_done FROM jobs WHERE id LIKE 'crash-%' AND status!='done'; SELECT COUNT(*) AS bad_attempts FROM jobs WHERE id LIKE 'crash-%' AND attempts != …

actions.description: Concurrent POST storm while worker drains
actions.command:
# concurrent submission + drain while worker runs
(for i in $(seq 1 40); do curl -s -o /dev/null -d "conc-$i" http://127.0.0.1:8080/jobs/conc-$i & done; wait)
sleep 3
sqlite3 /var/lib/job-queue/jobs.sqlite3 "SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(status='done') AS done, SUM(attempts != 1) AS bad_attempts, SUM(result != 'processed:conc-' || substr(id, 6)) AS bad_results FROM jobs WHERE id LIKE 'conc-%';"
